camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public QueryWorksByOrganization --region cn-hangzhou --Status 0 --WorksType PAGE --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --ThirdPartAuthFlag 1 --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries all works in an organization. You can specify the work type
description_zh: 查询整个组织下的所有作品，可指定作品类型
name: QueryWorksByOrganization

parameters.help_en:
The type of works to query. Leave this parameter empty to query all types. Valid values:

DATAPRODUCT: data portal
PAGE: dashboard
REPORT: workbook
dashboardOfflineQuery: custom query
parameters.help_zh:
查询作品的类型，填空为查询所有类型。取值范围：

DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
PAGE：仪表板
REPORT：电子表格
dashboardOfflineQuery：自助取数
parameters.name: works_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the works to query. Valid values:

0: Unpublished.
1: Published.
2: Modified but not published.
3: Offline
parameters.help_zh:
查询作品的状态。取值范围：

0：未发布
1：已发布
2：已修改未发布
3：已下线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The third-party embedding status. Valid values:

0: Embedding is not enabled.
1: Embedding is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
第三方嵌入状态。取值范围：

0：暂未开通嵌入
1：已开通嵌入
parameters.name: third_part_auth_flag

parameters.help_en:
The number of rows per page.

Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

Result.description_en: The list of all works in the organization that match the request conditions
Result.description_zh: 返回组织下所有符合请求条件的作品列表

Data.description_en: The details of the works list

Auth3rdFlag.description_en:
The third-party embedding status. Valid values:

0: Embedding is not enabled.
1: Embedding is enabled
Auth3rdFlag.description_zh:
第三方嵌入状态。取值范围：

0：暂未开通嵌入
1：已开通嵌入

Directory.description_en: The directory to which the work belongs

PathId.description_en: The hierarchical structure of directory IDs, separated by forward slashes (/)
PathId.description_zh: 所属目录ID的层级结构，以『/』分隔

PathName.description_en: The hierarchical structure of directory names, separated by forward slashes (/)
PathName.description_zh: 所属目录名称的层级结构，以『/』分隔

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp when the work was created, in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 作品创建的毫秒级时间戳

GmtModify.description_en: The timestamp when the work was last modified, in milliseconds
GmtModify.description_zh: 作品修改的毫秒级时间戳

ModifyName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name of the user who last modified the work
ModifyName.description_zh: 作品修改者的阿里云账户名

OwnerId.description_en: The Quick BI user ID of the work owner
OwnerId.example: 作品所属工作空间名称。

OwnerName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name of the work owner
OwnerName.description_zh: 作品所有者的阿里云账户名

PublicFlag.description_en: Indicates whether the work is public

PublicInvalidTime.description_en: The expiration date for the public report, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
PublicInvalidTime.description_zh: 报表公开的截止日期，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

SecurityLevel.description_en:
The security policy for collaborative authorization of the work. Valid values:
0: Private.
12: Authorized to specified members.
1 or 11: Authorized to all workspace members.

If you use the legacy permissions, the return value is 1.
If you use the new permissions, the return value is 11
SecurityLevel.description_zh:
作品协同授权的安全策略。取值：
0：私密
12：授权指定成员
1或11：授权所有空间成员

若您使用旧版权限，则返回值为1。
若您使用新版权限，则返回值为11

Status.description_en:
The report status. Valid values:

0: Unpublished.
1: Published.
2: Modified but not published.
3: Offline
Status.description_zh:
报表状态。取值范围：

0：未发布
1：已发布
2：已修改未发布
3：已下线

WorkType.description_en:
The type of the work. Valid values:

DATAPRODUCT: data portal
PAGE: dashboard
REPORT: workbook
dashboardOfflineQuery: custom query
WorkType.description_zh:
作品类型。取值范围：

DATAPRODUCT：数据门户
PAGE：仪表板
REPORT：电子表格
dashboardOfflineQuery：自助取数

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the work belongs
WorkspaceId.example: 作品修改者的阿里云账户名。

WorkspaceName.description_en: The name of the workspace to which the work belongs
WorkspaceName.description_zh: 作品所属工作空间名称

PageSize.description_en: The number of rows per page specified in the request
PageSize.description_zh: 请求接口时设置的每页行数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed

是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
